  between(pickup_latitude,   LAT_MIN, LAT_MAX) &

]

  pickup_dow   = lubridate::wday(pickup_datetime, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
  pickup_month = lubridate::month(pickup_datetime, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
  is_weekend   = lubridate::wday(pickup_datetime) %in% c(1, 7),
  is_night     = lubridate::hour(pickup_datetime) %in% c(0:5, 20:23),
  rush_hour    = lubridate::hour(pickup_datetime) %in% c(7:10, 16:19)
)]
haversine_km <- function(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2) {
  rad <- pi/180
  lon1 <- lon1 * rad; lat1 <- lat1 * rad
  lon2 <- lon2 * rad; lat2 <- lat2 * rad
  dlon <- lon2 - lon1
  dlat <- lat2 - lat1
  a <- sin(dlat/2)^2 + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dlon/2)^2
  c <- 2 * asin(pmin(1, sqrt(a)))
  6371 * c
}

train_clean[, haversine_km := haversine_km(
  pickup_longitude, pickup_latitude,
  dropoff_longitude, dropoff_latitude
)]

summary(train_clean$haversine_km)

set.seed(1)
plot_df <- train_clean[sample(.N, min(.N, 200000))] |> as_tibble()

ggplot(plot_df, aes(fare_amount)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(haversine_km, fare_amount)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.15)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(pickup_hour, fare_amount)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.05)

set.seed(1)
model_df <- train_clean[sample(.N, 800000)]
model_df <- as.data.frame(model_df)
m1 <- lm(fare_amount ~ haversine_km, data = model_df)

m2 <- lm(fare_amount ~ haversine_km + passenger_count + pickup_hour +
           pickup_dow + pickup_month + is_night + is_weekend + rush_hour,
         data = model_df)

m3 <- lm(fare_amount ~ haversine_km * rush_hour + passenger_count +
           pickup_dow + is_night + is_weekend,
         data = model_df)

summary(m2)
